recognize_zh: 高倍下可見一大團緊密黏聚、呈合胞體樣排列的小圓藍細胞，核圓且大小相近、核質比很高，細胞之間夾有淡藍紫色細絲狀物質；造血細胞在抹片上不會這樣成團黏聚，這種細胞團（伴有類似玫瑰花環排列）指向轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large cohesive, syncytial-appearing cluster of small round blue cells
High N:C ratio with round to oval nuclei, relatively uniform size and occasional nuclear molding
Fine to slightly granular chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm merging with faint fibrillary intercellular material (neuropil-like)
Possible vague rosette-like arrangement around central fibrillary material, not sharply defined in this photograph
Background grey-tinted red cells; camera photo with limited sharpness
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a large cohesive cluster of small round blue cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to oval nuclei with focal molding, and fine chromatin without prominent nucleoli. The cells are embedded in scant pale cytoplasm and faint fibrillary material, with a vague rosette-like arrangement, although a well-formed Homer Wright rosette is not sharply resolved in this photograph. Cohesive clusters of this type are not a feature of hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts do not form cohesive clusters with molding or neuropil, and they express CD45 and TdT.
Ewing sarcoma may cluster but typically lacks neuropil and true Homer Wright rosettes, and is CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 fusion.
Rhabdomyosarcoma clusters can mimic this but show cytoplasmic vacuoles and occasional multinucleation and are desmin/myogenin-positive.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte clusters or aspirate clumps of normal precursors
ddx.vs: Normal marrow clumps contain a mixture of maturing lineages with granules and varied cell sizes, rather than a monotonous molded population.
